answer: Shared Operator Accountability Pool: each operator must post one deposit covering all wallets it runs and is identified by a persistent device/network fingerprint. Any wallet proven sybil-farmed forfeits a fraction of the whole pool, not just that wallet, so an attacker farming N identities risks one deposit per operator, not N cheap deposits. Operators also cross-guarantee via a karst-like ledger of signed relationships; a sonnet of attestations per identity raises forgery cost. The oasis of clean operators keeps collateral low;
